tasks.label: Open in Default Browser
tasks.command: node -e "const { exec } = require('child_process'); const url = 'http://localhost:8080/'; const cmd = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'start "" "' + url + '"' : (process.platform === 'darwin' ? 'open "' + url + '"' : 'xdg-open "' + url + '"'); exec(cmd);"

tasks.label: Open in Firefox
tasks.command: node -e "const { exec } = require('child_process'); const cmd = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'start firefox http://localhost:8080/' : 'firefox http://localhost:8080/'; exec(cmd);"
